jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) JASMINE & MUSK LIQUID SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Perfumed liquid hand and body soap. Comes in a container with a dispenser.

Jasmine & Musk | A radiant veil of creamy, intimate amber slowly and gently seduces the environment, embracing the quest for eternal comfort. Calm yet deep floral notes illuminate a velvety accord thanks to its elegant and warm aura.

Notes:
Top notes: pear blossom, peach.
Heart notes: ambroxan, tonka bean, jasmine, iris.
Base notes: musk, white cedar, patchouli.
